title: Network Management: Main Exam, 22 April 2021
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: List the four roles of a network administrator.
Discuss the functions of the SNMP protocol to a network administrator.

Explain the three functions of a network operating system with the aid of an example network operating system such as Netware or Windows 2000 and above, bringing out each service that it uses to meet each of the three functions.
When designing a network one has to consider whether to implement a peer-to-peer or a client-server network. List and explain at least three factors that are to be considered.

Mount Kenya University requires a network that will cater for administrative and student needs. The users range from lecturers, administrative assistants and students. All types of users need to access the internet through the network. The university management also requires wireless access. The university members of staff need to access the university management system, which should not be accessed by students. The total number of expected users is 200 at any given time.
Which is the most appropriate network topology for this network? Give the reasons for your answer.
What network devices will be used while designing the network? Briefly explain their use.
Which is the most appropriate class of IP address and its subnet mask for this network? Give a reason for your answer.

Explain how the following factors might influence the design decisions you make. a) The geographical area to be covered by the network b) The number of users c) The extent to which e-commerce is used between the company and its (external) trading partners
List down and explain the function of each of the seven layers of the ISO OSI networking model.
IP addresses are classified as class A, B, C, D and E. Explain why it is necessary to classify IP addresses into these classes and the importance of subnetting.
Explain at least four reasons that have made TCP/IP so popular.
Differentiate, with the help of examples, between routing protocols, routed protocols and non-routed protocols.
Explain the difference between the following terminologies as used in networking.
Dedicated and non-dedicated servers
DNS and DHCP

You are hired as a consultant in company K. You have identified that the company does not have proper ways of managing the network. You need to develop a proper network management. Identify the network management functional key areas.
Explain four security enhancements that can be implemented on a network.
Network documentation is important for both troubleshooting and also for implementing a change on the network. List and discuss at least three software tools used to document network performance.
Explaining what a bottleneck is, list at least four devices that tend to become bottlenecks.
Troubleshooting is an inevitable part of network design and implementation. Describe three hardware tools and two software tools used in troubleshooting.
Briefly explain any two factors that will influence the choice of a NIC for a particular computer.
Describe the four components that need to be installed and configured in the Local Area Connection properties dialog to enable network communication and sharing.
Outline four benefits of computer network management to an organization.
